'''Neimoidia''', also called '''Pure Neimoidia''' to avoid confusion with the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]], was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region that the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] from [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] colonized sometime around [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], bringing it into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
Neimoidia was ruled by a [[Trade monarch/Legends|trade monarch]], reflecting the Neimoidian's obsession with trade, commerce, and money. That was also present in the [[Neimoidian Inner Circle]], a cabal with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The Neimoidians established purse worlds on nearby [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], [[Deko Neimoidia/Legends|Deko Neimoidia]], and [[Koru Neimoidia/Legends|Koru Neimoidia]]. Neimoidia was populated by the less capable and aggressive members of the species, all others moving off-world as soon as possible. Many low-level worker drones were kept malnourished so as to never reach full mental maturity. Combined with the planet's natural unpleasantness, it was usual for Neimoidians to choose not to return home unless absolutely necessary.

[[File:Neimoidia.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A settlement on Neimoidia]]

===Biosphere===
Neimoidia was known for its [[Manax tree/Legends|manax tree]] orchards, [[Beetle/Legends|beetle]] hatcheries, [[Insect/Legends|insect]] hives, and [[fungus farm]]s, tended by [[Harvester beetle/Legends|harvester beetles]]. Such orchards and farms, as well as the beetles, were established on all the purse worlds. Other known native species include [[Mistfly/Legends|Mistfly]], [[Neekoflight/Legends|Neekoflights]] and [[Pylat bird/Legends|Pylat]].

==History==
===Early history===
Around [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Chla C'cHaan|Chal Haan]] led a group of Duros explorers to colonize the planet Neimoidia.<ref name="Neimodian">{{TORcite|type=codex|Neimodian}}</ref> Neimoidia joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] early in its history, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

By [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the inhabitants had evolved to the point when they could be considered a separate [[Species/Legends|species]] from their Duros ancestors. The genetic differences from the Duros that the Neimoidians developed were attributed to the features of the planet, including its heavier gravity, dimmer sun, humidity, and perpetual fog and mist.

By [[4800 BBY]], the Neimoidians locked up the distribution rights of newly-discovered [[Ryll/Legends|ryll spice]] from [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Their irresponsible distribution of this drug led to the [[Gank Massacres]], including the extinction of the [[Porporite]]s.

===Rise of the Trade Federation===
The Neimoidians helped found the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in [[350 BBY/Legends|350 BBY]] as a cartel of [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and businessmen, although their defense force may have been some centuries older.

[[File:Desperate_Allies_FC_character_art.png|thumb|left|150px|A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]]]]

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray took over [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]] and then monopolized the [[Trade Federation Directorate|Trade Federation Executive Board]], resulting in [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] leaving the Trade Federation. To offset this loss, the Neimoidians acquired KDY corporate secrets through corrupt KDY officers whom set up [[Kuati Security Forces]] officer [[Kalyn Farnmir/Legends|Kalyn Farnmir]] to take the fall.

After the failed [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Trade Federation [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] was ordered to tell [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] to disband the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid army]]. Fearing an attack from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] if they would not comply, the Trade Federation leaders seemingly complied by [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], but fled Neimoidia for the three purse worlds to continue the development of their army well into the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

===The Clone Wars===
[[File:Neimoidia_TEA.jpg|thumb|230px|Neimoidia]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] Neimoidia was in an arms race with neighbouring [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. Unlike [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] shipyards at [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] and [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]], Neimoidia's [[Neimoidian shipyards|shipyards]] weren't protected by distance from the frontlines. As orbital screens were erected around Kuat's most guarded shipyards, Neimoidia took similar sensor-baffling measures to protect its shipyards from Republic intelligence gathering.<ref name="CSD-15:01:15" /> The Republic took Neimoidia and its purse worlds from the Separatists in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. During the [[Battle on Neimoidia/Legends|battle]], Neimoidia was ravaged, and the destruction of many Neimoidian [[Neimoidian communal hive|grub hatcheries]] would affect the Neimoidian species, in a more positive way.

Later, Viceroy Gunray and [[Settlement Officer/Legends|Settlement Officer]] [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] were [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|killed]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. A few days after the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] was massacred, with the rise of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Trade Federation was made a puppet government to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] after Acting Viceroy [[Sentepeth Findos]] [[Imperial–Trade Federation treaty|signed a treaty]] on Neimoidia. The Neimoidians began to adopt the culture of the baseline Duros to disassociate themselves with the Trade Federation's shameful legacy, where they presumably changed their culture, first by destroying the remaining grub hatcheries and burning down all the [[fungus farm]]s. Afterwards, Neimoidians rarely travelled, unless shifty dealings were afoot. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Trade Federation was officially [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|disbanded]] with the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], but there was still [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|some of the militia]] that had [[Trade Federation resistance|remained]].

===Later History===
In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], Neimoidia was quarantined due to viruses. This was not the first time such a precaution had been taken; numerous diseases and viruses originated on the planet, with the Neimoidians propagating them throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Intestinal Revenge of Bars Barka]], which led to severe weight loss among [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] colonists, as well as [[Great Pandemic of Deersheba]], both called Neimoidia home. According to a joke made by [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]], onetime doctor for a Neimoidian fleet, "the principal export of the Neimoidian home planet is [[Brainworm Rot Type C]]".

Some Neimoidians joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], while others fell into criminal groups.
